description: This file defines a protocol and a class related to node runtime services on macOS, including screen recording and location services.

classes.name: LiveMacNodeRuntimeMainActorServices
classes.description: Implements the MacNodeRuntimeMainActorServices protocol, providing screen recording and location services for macOS.

methods.name: recordScreen
methods.description: Asynchronously records a screen with specified parameters, returning the output path and audio presence.

methods.name: locationAuthorizationStatus
methods.description: Returns the current location authorization status.

methods.name: locationAccuracyAuthorization
methods.description: Returns the current location accuracy authorization status.

methods.name: currentLocation
methods.description: Retrieves the current location asynchronously, considering desired accuracy and time constraints.
